Protests Erupt Over Killing of Police Havildar's Son in Arrah

Protests and a candlelight march demanding justice have taken place in Arrah following the killing of Rithik Singh, the son of a police havildar. Demonstrators are calling for the arrest of those responsible for his death. The protests have reportedly involved public outcry and a candlelight march.
